mentions.note: won 1950 Inter-Counties, Northern and National cross country; 4th in the international at Brussels

photos.c: "Athletics Weekly" first made its appearance in 1950, before that year being only a monthly publication. Editor was P.W. "Jimmy" Green - now a Life Member of Belgrave Harriers. The cover picture for March 25th 1950 shows Dr. Frank Aaron leading the Senior National Cross Country Championship at Aylesbury after 2 miles. Others in the picture are Hicks, behind Aaron, Olney (811), Birch (343) and Eyre (349).
